description: Three requested sections: History (narrative), Medications (table) and Social history (omit,
no notes). The case drafts History as prose and Medications as a table and takes no branch for
Social history, which coverage names as left out; only History gets a patient-facing line.
include_billing true, so the billing standing section is drafted.

inputs.consult_draft: Ana Souza, 72, seen for falls. Two falls in a month; postural drop 24 mmHg. On doxazosin, ramipril and bendroflumethiazide. Doxazosin stopped today; review in three weeks; return sooner if she faints. New patient, 40 minutes. (Fictional.)
